privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1p1: Deutschmeister ("we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use the Deutschmeister German learning platform.
privacy.s1p2: We are a personal project, built by a German learner in Vietnam. We are not a large company and we do not aim to exploit user data.
privacy.s2_1l3: Password (hashed with bcrypt, we cannot read it)
privacy.s2_2l1: Words learned, learning progress, exam scores
privacy.s2_2l3: Personal settings: level, daily study goals
privacy.s2_3p: If you sign in with Google or Facebook, we only receive: name, email, and avatar from the OAuth provider. We do not access contacts, friends, or any other data.
privacy.s2_4l1: Cookies: we only use an httpOnly cookie for the authentication refresh token
privacy.s2_4l3: No Google Analytics or any tracking service
privacy.s3l1: To provide and improve the German learning service
privacy.s3l2: To personalise the learning experience (lesson suggestions, goals)
privacy.s3l3: To send account confirmation emails and study reminders (can be disabled in Settings)
privacy.s3p: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with any third party for advertising or commercial purposes.
privacy.s4p: Deutschmeister uses Google Gemini AI to generate exams, grade writing and speaking. When you use AI features:
privacy.s4l1: Your writing and speech are sent to the Google Gemini API for processing
privacy.s4l2: This data is handled per Google Cloud's privacy policy
privacy.s4l3: We do not store audio recordings — only the transcript (text)
privacy.s4l4: Grading results are saved so you can review them
privacy.s5l2: Access token stored in memory (not localStorage)
privacy.s5l5: PostgreSQL database protected by the hosting provider
privacy.s6l1Body: — see all your personal information on the Settings page
privacy.s6l3Body: — request account and full data deletion (contact via email)
privacy.s6l4Body: — request export of your learning data
privacy.s6l5Body: — turn off reminder emails in Settings
privacy.s7p: Deutschmeister is for users aged 13 and over. We don't intentionally collect data from children under 13. If you are a parent and find your child has registered, please contact us to delete the account.
privacy.s8p: We may update this policy over time. Any changes will be announced on the website. Your continued use after updates means you agree to the new policy.
privacy.s9p: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact:

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.s1p1: By using Deutschmeister, you agree to comply with these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.
terms.s1p2: Deutschmeister is a free online German learning platform built by an individual in Vietnam. It is not a Goethe-Institut or TELC product — we only simulate exam formats to support practice.
terms.s2l1: You must provide accurate information when registering
terms.s2l2: You are responsible for your account security (password, device)
terms.s2l3: Each person should only have one account
terms.s2l4: You must be 13 or over to use the service
terms.s2l5: We may suspend or delete accounts that violate the terms
terms.s3_1p: All content on Deutschmeister (vocabulary, exercises, interface, source code) belongs to Deutschmeister. You may not copy, distribute, or use it commercially without consent.
terms.s3_2p: Exams, readings, questions are generated by Google Gemini AI. This content is generated automatically and may not be 100% perfect. We do not guarantee absolute accuracy of AI content.
terms.s3_3p: Writing, speaking, and personal vocabulary that you create belong to you. By submitting it, you allow us to process (send to AI for grading) and store it for your review.
terms.s4l1: Use bots or scripts to spam the system
terms.s4l2: Attempt to intrude, attack, or exploit security vulnerabilities
terms.s4l3: Impersonate others or create multiple fake accounts
terms.s4l4: Use the service for illegal purposes
terms.s4l5: Copy exams for resale or commercial use
terms.s5p: Deutschmeister currently provides all features free of charge. However:
terms.s5l1: AI features (exam generation, grading) have daily usage limits to control API costs
terms.s5l2: We may change limits or introduce paid plans in the future with prior notice
terms.s5l3: The service may be interrupted for maintenance, upgrades, or technical issues
terms.s6p1: Deutschmeister is provided "as-is". We strive for quality but do not guarantee:
terms.s6l1: Learning content is 100% accurate (especially AI-generated content)
terms.s6l2: The service runs continuously without interruption
terms.s6l3: Mock exam results match real exam results
terms.s6l4: Deutschmeister is not an official Goethe/TELC certifying authority
terms.s6p2: Learning German and exam results depend on your personal effort. Deutschmeister is a supporting tool, not a guarantee of success.
terms.s7p: The collection and processing of personal data is governed by our <link>Privacy policy</link>, which is an inseparable part of these terms.
terms.s8l1: You may stop using the service at any time
terms.s8l2: You can request account deletion via email
terms.s8l3: We may terminate accounts that violate the terms
terms.s8l4: When an account is deleted, learning data is permanently removed
terms.s9p: We may update these terms. Changes will be announced on the website. Continued use after updates means you agree to the new terms.

faq.a1: After bank transfer or scanning the VietQR code, the admin will confirm your transaction. Usually this takes 1–4 hours, max 24 hours.
faq.q2: What are the Lifetime plan benefits?
faq.a2: You pay once and own all current and future Premium features forever. You also receive an exclusive Early Backer badge.
faq.a3: We offer 100% refund within the first 7 days if you're unsatisfied and haven't used more than 10 AI practice sessions.
faq.q4: What if I use up my Free AI quota?
faq.a4: You can still learn vocabulary, grammar, and play mini-games normally. AI practice sessions refresh every Monday.
faq.q5: How does the referral commission work?
faq.a5: Each account has a unique referral code (see on the Referral page). When friends sign up with your code and pay for Premium 3 months, 1 year, or lifetime, you receive 5% / 10% / 15% commission to your balance. Monthly plans, Lite plans, and exam bundle don't earn commission.
faq.q6: How do I withdraw commission to cash?
faq.a6: Go to the Referral page, press "Withdraw", enter your bank account and the amount (minimum 50,000đ). Admin reviews and transfers within 1–3 business days.
faq.q7: How does the referral discount work for new users?
faq.a7: When you enter a referral code at signup, you get 10% off your first purchase of any paid plan (Lite / Premium / Lifetime / Exam Bundle). The offer applies once and doesn't stack with other promo codes.
